Luna is the native token of the Terra blockchain, which operates as a public blockchain. Luna uses a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism. Luna was the token whose collapse in May 2022 followed the depegging of the algorithmic stablecoin UST. Luna has a successor chain, Terra 2.0, which was launched after the collapse.

Hedera Hashgraph is a public distributed ledger that uses the hashgraph consensus algorithm rather than a traditional blockchain structure. Hedera Hashgraph is governed by a council of organizations. Hedera Hashgraph uses HBAR as its native cryptocurrency.

Solana is a public layer-1 blockchain. Solana combines a proof-of-history mechanism with proof-of-stake consensus. Solana uses SOL as its native token. Solana is designed for high transaction throughput.

MANTRA is a blockchain focused on real-world asset tokenization. MANTRA uses OM as its native token. MANTRA is built on the Cosmos SDK.
